description: Athletics results: result codes (DNS, DNF, NM, DQ…), rounding of times, distances and wind, tie rules, combined-events scoring formula and parameters with checks against the printed tables.
status: ready for World Athletics rules; PASI U14/U16 and school championships (O2SN, POPDA/POPNAS) pending brief R-10b
source: World Athletics Book C C1.1/C2.1 Competition & Technical Rules (amendments effective up to 2026-03-20, PDF 2026-07-17); IAAF Scoring Tables for Combined Events (2016). Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/atletik/
licence: Copyright World Athletics; facts with references used under decision F-027
procedure: Transcribed by hand into tools/converters/atletik.py, which checks the scoring parameters against printed table rows and the tables for completeness, then writes the three sets.
